description: SPH particle-field, smoothing-length, support-radius, neighbor-view, and ownership contract. Hydrodynamic state is owned separately from gravity state while sharing the particle identity of the existing SoA boundaries. No equation of state is chosen here.
shared_identity: hydro execution state lives per particle of the existing SoA; identity is the stable particle ID and active mask of the particle arena; hydrodynamic fields never create or destroy particles, never fork the mask, and never mutate mass, position, or canonical velocity

density.lifetime: hydro execution state, recomputed each hydro update from the deterministic neighbor summation rho_i = sum_j m_j W(r_ij, h_i)
density.initialization: rest-lattice summation over the deterministic local-neighbor index contract or an explicit run parameter; the uniform rest lattice reproduces the analytic rho_0 to the symmetric-kernel tolerance

pressure.lifetime: derived quantity, recomputed from density and the chosen EOS at every hydro update; never stored as restart state
pressure.eos_policy: the concrete EOS is selected by P8-SPH-004; Tait with gamma = 7 is the wcsp-v1 contract default and the only retained candidate until the EOS issue decides

specific_internal_energy.lifetime: integrated state of the energy slot of the existing fixed-step split, checkpointed with the run state
specific_internal_energy.initialization: isotropic reference internal energy derived from the rest density and sound speed, or an explicit run parameter

smoothing_length.lifetime: per-particle hydro execution state resolved each hydro update; compact support radius is exactly 2 h_i
smoothing_length.consistency: h_i and rho_i obey a deterministic fixed-point consistency h_i = eta (m_i / rho_i)^(1/3) with a declared iteration count, evaluated over the same neighbor index; the tolerance and iteration count are recorded parameters

reserved_entropy_slot.units: mass / length^(3 gamma - 3) for the retained entropy form
reserved_entropy_slot.lifetime: reserved; not initialized and not integrated until P8-SPH-007 freezes the ysph-v1 definition
reserved_entropy_slot.policy: no production code may read or write the slot before that confirmation

neighbor_views.index: the deterministic local-neighbor index contract of plan/neighborhood.json (bounded, non-allocating, candidate cell-linked-v1 selected)
neighbor_views.extent: support radius 2 h_i plus the index skin, evaluated with the inclusive squared-distance comparison
neighbor_views.iteration: neighbor views iterate in ascending native target and source index order; iteration is deterministic and bounded by the index capacity
neighbor_views.allocation: neighbor views do not allocate during a step; steady state after warmup stays allocation-free
neighbor_views.candidates: cell-linked, hash, Octree, and k-d candidates interoperate through the same index boundary; no hydro code builds a spatial index of its own

cases.empty: a particle with no source within support has rho_i = 0; validation rejects zero and non-finite densities before any update and rolls back to the step checkpoint with a recorded failure
cases.boundary: periodic boundaries follow the PBC contract with the symmetric-kernel summation giving an identical neighbor set on both sides; finite boxes follow the neighborhood finite-box probe
cases.duplicate: the index guarantees each directed (target, source) pair at most once; a duplicate entry is a quality error of the index, not a hydro condition

ownership.local: each owned particle owns its density, pressure, energy, and smoothing length; the owner rank evaluates the full hydro update from its deterministic views
ownership.mpi: MPI-owned particles (P8) carry hydrodynamic state through the same index and ownership bundles; no hydro quantity is ghosted and no cross-rank momentum or energy exchange exists beyond the P8 migration contract
ownership.identity: ownership transfer and restart (P9) move hydrodynamic state together with the particle identity; snapshots publish the hydro state of the active set

interface_rules: hydro implementation evaluates through the existing SolverForceEvaluation boundary; no new solver entry point
gravity fields, integrator splits, checkpoint, rollback, and no-hot-path-allocation rules match the KDK/comoving integrators
gravity-only trajectories and all pre-existing test ids are unchanged
new hydro tests and quality phases use the P10 phase with TST-P10-* ids
